Dashboards

West Boundary Agricultural Water Security
A pilot dashboard for the RDKB West Boundary planning process (Kettle River watershed, Midway and upstream), including:

current flow status for each monitoring station, scored against decades of record
an interactive drought view comparing this year’s flow to the historical normal range
a project-area map of stations and communities, plus seasonal climatology

title: Home
text:
Notes on methodology
Forecasts on this site are intentionally lightweight and transparent. Where applicable, we use simple time-series benchmarks (e.g. random walk variants) to provide context rather than precise prediction.
